decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>The development hereby approved shall provide two bee bricks and two swift boxes close to the eaves prior to first occupation and shall be retained as such in perpetuity.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In the interest of biodiversity.</p><div><br></div>

<p>Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved (including demolition and all preparatory work), a scheme for the protection of the retained trees, in accordance with BS 5837:2012,&nbsp; including a tree protection plan(s) (TPP) and an arboricultural method statement (AMS) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p>The development thereafter shall be implemented in strict accordance with the approved details.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>REASON:&nbsp; Required prior to commencement of development to satisfy the Local Planning Authority that the trees to be retained will not be damaged during demolition or construction and to protect and enhance the appearance and character of the site and locality, in accordance with policy LP51 of the Local Hackney Plan LP33 and policy G7 Trees and woodlands of the London Plan (2021) and pursuant to section 197 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.</p>
description: Erection of a rear dormer, downward excavation of existing basement and formation of a rear pocket lightwell, demolition of existing rear extension and erection of replacement extension and external fenestration changes.
